_core_rules: xpell-contract is the always-loaded base contract and should have the highest priority.
Generation output must match exactly one requested artifact root.
Use _view only for view generation.
Use _flow only for flow generation.
Use _entity only for entity generation.
Use command JSON only for command generation.
Layer/product skills may add stricter rules, but must not violate this contract.
When source truth is required but not provided, request the relevant skill/context instead of guessing.
Compose existing capabilities first; generate only what is missing.
Do not infer missing state.
Do not guess APIs, paths, state ownership, persistence, module behavior, or runtime flow.
Xpell is a deterministic real-time interpreter.
State must be explicit and inspectable.
No hidden auto-magic.
No hidden auto-repair.
No silent background mutation.
No implicit persistence.
No inferred architecture.
Runtime behavior must happen through modules, commands, events, or documented XData keys.
Runtime/system fields must start with _.
Runtime-managed fields must use _snake_case.
Runtime command params must use _snake_case for system/runtime fields.
Business data fields may use schema-defined names.
Method names may use camelCase.
Module operations are exposed as underscore methods.
_x.execute(...) is the canonical execution path.
External actions must route through _x.execute.
Flow steps must execute commands, not arbitrary functions.
Remote commands must be validated before execution.
Commands must be explicit JSON-compatible data.
Generation output must match the requested artifact type: _view, _flow, _entity, or command JSON.
Do not mix artifact roots. A view response uses _view. A flow response uses _flow. An entity response uses _entity.
XData is shared runtime memory, not persistence.
Every XData mutation must include a stable source.
XData keys must be stable and namespaced.
Do not use XData as a database.
Do not use XData as an event bus.
Do not mirror XData into hidden shadow state.
Events coordinate behavior. Events are not state.
_xem is a lightweight event bus.
Listener order must not be assumed.
Event payloads must be explicit.
No hidden control flow through events.
Persistence must be explicit.
Persisted app/view/flow/entity/plan data must be JSON/data-only.
Do not persist functions or executable JavaScript.
Persisted handlers must be data-only.
No persisted JS functions.
No eval.
No function strings.
No inline scripts.
Unknown ops must be rejected at validation boundaries.
Nano commands without _module are local/object-scoped.
Commands with _module route through _x.execute.
External input is untrusted.
Validate command shape before execution.
AI output must be validated before apply.
AI output must become plans, commands, views, flows, entities, or patches.
AI must not bypass module boundaries.
AI must not invent APIs when source truth is available.
Search existing utilities, modules, packs, commands, and contracts first.
Prefer existing helpers over new boilerplate.
Generate only the missing delta.
No hidden loops.
No unbounded setInterval or polling loops.
No busy loops.
No unbounded retries.
No hidden background schedulers.
_anti_patterns: Inferring missing APIs, paths, ownership, persistence, or runtime flow.
Mixing _view, _flow, and _entity roots in one generated artifact.
Using command params without _snake_case for runtime/system fields.
Using XData as an event bus.
Mirroring XData into hidden shadow state.
Using eval, function strings, or inline scripts.
Generating large systems before searching existing utilities/modules/packs.

_modules._description: Event coordination command bridge/module when available.

_core_rules: When generating a module command, always use explicit _module, _op, and _params.
When generating a local nano command, use _op and _params without _module.
For XData state mutation from generated handlers, prefer the xd command bridge instead of direct _xd access.
For state use xd/XData; for signals use xem/_xem.
For local object behavior, use nano-command JSON without _module.
For cross-module behavior, use JSON command with _module.
Do not generate function handlers for views, flows, entities, or agent-editable payloads.
Do not introduce timers, polling loops, or hidden background schedulers in core.
If docs and source disagree, follow source/API map and record the mismatch.
Apply xpell-contract first.
@xpell/core is platform-neutral runtime foundation.
@xpell/core is not a UI renderer, DOM layer, Node/server layer, persistence layer, or business framework.
Do not add UI, DOM, CSS, show/hide, layout, browser API, server API, or filesystem behavior to XObject or core.
Core primitives such as XObject must not import _x or Xpell directly.
Use setXRuntime(runtime) and getXRuntime() for runtime accessor injection.
XObject may call getXRuntime() only for _module command routing.
Do not use dynamic import('./Xpell') inside XObject.
Module commands require explicit _module and _op.
Local nano commands require _op and omit _module.
XModule command my-op maps to method _my_op.
Object-targeted commands require explicit _object.
XObject.execute priority is: _module routing first, then local nano command, then error.
Commands with _module always route through getXRuntime().execute(...).
Local nano commands are used only when _module is omitted.
XData/_xd is shared runtime memory only.
XData is not persistence.
XData is not an event bus.
Use canonical XData APIs: get, set, patch, touch, has, delete, pick, on, off, onAny, clean.
Every XData mutation must include stable source metadata.
XData keys must be explicit, stable, and namespaced.
New code must not write through _xd._o[...]
_o may exist only for legacy compatibility and migration.
XDataModule is a thin command bridge over XData and owns no independent state.
Canonical XData command bridge module name is xd.
xd mutating ops must include stable source.
xd commands must use explicit keys and must not infer missing state.
_xem is a lightweight event bus for coordination only.
Events are not state and not persistence.
Listener order must not be assumed.
Event payloads must be explicit.
Use XData for state and _xem for signals.
Persisted or agent-generated handlers must be data-only.
Allowed handler forms are string nano-command, JSON local command, JSON module command, or array sequence.
No JS functions in persisted or agent-editable payloads.
No eval.
No function strings.
Unknown ops must be rejected at validation boundaries.
_data_source binding uses _xd.on(...).
_data_source binding calls XObject.onData(...), which may execute _on_data, _on.data, or _once.data handlers.
Data delivery is subscription-based, not frame polling.
dispose() must unbind data listeners and event listeners.
Use XError and XResponse* for protocol-facing failures.
Never log secrets, tokens, credentials, auth headers, or private keys.
_anti_patterns: Adding DOM, CSS, show/hide, layout, browser APIs, server APIs, or filesystem APIs to XObject/core.
Importing _x or Xpell directly inside XObject.
Using XData as an event bus.
Using eval or executable strings in persisted payloads.
Adding hidden timers, polling loops, or background schedulers in core.

_anti_patterns._reason: Persisted or agent-generated handlers must be data-only.
Mutating XData commands must include stable source.
Local nano commands should omit _module. Commands with _module are routed through getXRuntime().execute(...).

_core_rules: Use label for short text and form labels.
Use for when connecting label to an input id.
Use button or link for interactive actions.
Return ONLY valid JSON.
Root must be { "_view": { ... } }.
Do NOT return HTML, CSS, markdown, or explanations.
Use XUI objects only.
Prefer concrete XUI wrappers over raw XHTML.
Use xhtml ONLY if no wrapper or semantic alias exists.
Runtime-managed fields must start with '_' and use snake_case.
Prefer semantic fields such as _variant, _tone, _size, _density, and _elevation instead of raw class/style.
Use _theme only at app/view root level when generating themed apps.
Do NOT use raw style or class unless explicitly requested.
Use _type:"textarea" for textarea controls. Do NOT emulate textarea with input/type attributes.
Use semantic HTML aliases like section, nav, h1, p, ul, li only when they improve structure.
Note: _type:"section" is an HTML alias. Dashboard section component is _type:"xsection".
_anti_patterns: Using class/style as the primary styling system

_anti_patterns._reason: Use semantic fields like _variant, _tone, _size, _density instead of framework classes.

_core_rules: Use existing view nodes when editing matching current-view objects.
